'''C-9PO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] belonging to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandell Mantracor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:OMMME" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
C-9PO was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OMMME" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
